name: helix-configurator
description: Root convenience scripts. The app lives in two self-contained packages (frontend/, backend/); these just fan out to both so you don't have to cd around. The Dockerfile builds each package directly and ignores this file.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
